description: 人格化的月亮运行者，与索尔共同构成日月秩序。
fullDescription: Máni是月亮的人格化运行者。来源并不要求他是魔法师，也不应通过‘手托月球’这类现代奇幻姿势表示月亮身份。重点应是与月体路径和夜空秩序的关系。
roleInSeries: 建立夜晚与月相运行的视觉锚点。

sourceRefs.note: 日月在初始宇宙秩序中的运行。

visualThesis: 冷色、安静但持续运动的人形月亮运行者，与月体保持空间关系，姿态克制。

interpretationNotes: 无需把后续其他月亮叙事元素塞入本卡
mustKeep: 比Sól更安静、横向/弧线运动

instructions: 与Sól：不同脸型、姿态、镜头与节奏，不是冷暖换色
与Hati：Máni是被追逐的天体秩序主体，不是狼形威胁

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、上身、月体路径关系高细节；星空背景极简。
visual.subjectSeparation: 冷银边缘光与深夜背景分离，避免满屏星点。

prompt.draft: Create Máni as the personified moon-runner, a calm masculine humanlike figure moving with the moon's ordered path. Do not depict a wizard holding the moon, using a staff, spell or cosmic UI. Keep the moon as a secondary celestial relationship, not a prop in his hand. Use muted indigo and silver light, simple clouds and very restrained stars. Make his face, silhouette, motion direction and composition clearly different from Sól. Crop-safe head and upper torso, painterly subject-first style.
prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone portrait 9:16 pure artwork for card 1003010013, Máni / 马尼, type character.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: Create Máni as the personified moon-runner, a calm masculine humanlike figure moving with the moon's ordered path. Do not depict a wizard holding the moon, using a staff, spell or cosmic UI. Keep the moon as a secondary celestial relationship, not a prop in his hand. Use muted indigo and silver light, simple clouds and very restrained stars. Make his face, silhouette, motion direction and composition clearly different from Sól. Crop-safe head and upper torso, painterly subject-first style.

Visual thesis: 冷色、安静但持续运动的人形月亮运行者，与月体保持空间关系，姿态克制。

Identity anchors: 人形月亮运行者；冷色夜空；安静运动；月体关系清楚

Must keep: 比Sól更安静、横向/弧线运动；不使用魔法师手势

Must avoid: 手托月亮；法杖；魔法师长袍模板；满屏星河；Sól换蓝色

Composition: camera eye level; shot three-quarter moving figure; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 冷银；靛蓝；灰紫；夜蓝; materials 织物；月光；薄云；风; mood calm-motion；lunar；cool；restrained.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010012；1003010015. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: holding moon；wizard pose；staff；magic spell；cosmic UI；ornamental starfield；Sól clone；Hati-like beast；glossy game-CG；typography; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
